pages.text: Tobin: $(italic)Right, so, the markers, they're not decoration, they're the box, the machine only eats what's inside the box, which is good, because otherwise it'd just --$()$(br2)Bram: $(italic)Tobin.$()$(br2)Q87 is the rig and its markers on the site Tobin surveyed. Q88 is $(bold)1,024 cobblestone$() out of network stock into the granary -- one bounded cycle. The quarry keeps running afterwards.
pages.title: The Shaft

pages.text: $(li)Put a $(item)Flexible Marker$() on the corner stake Tobin left.$(li)Right-click it and type the box you want.$(li)This pack caps a side at $(bold)256 blocks$(). Tobin's site is well inside that.$(li)Set $(item)Quarry Plus$() flat against the marker, facing in.$(li)Power it off the reactor grid. It builds its own frame.
pages.title: The easy way: one marker

pages.text: $(item)Marker Plus$() at three corners -- right-click each one to run its guide line out -- and the rectangle between them is the box. Same result, more walking.$(br2)$(bold)It keeps working when you log off.$() Chunk loading is on in this pack, so the shaft runs through the night and through your dinner.
pages.title: The old way: three markers

pages.text: The quarry will not craft without the $(item)Works Deed$(). The deed is $(bold)80 Valley Scrip$() at Oda's counter and needs $(bold)Standing: Trusted$() -- six of the eight resident chains closed.$(br2)Josie's reason for that is chalked on the cellar wall, and it is a good one.
pages.title: The gate
